genesis.46.p1.b1.text: So Israel set out with all that he had, and when he came to Beersheba,

genesis.46.p1.b2.text: he offered sacrifices to the God of his father Isaac.

genesis.46.p1.b5.text: Do not be afraid to go down to Egypt, … I will go down with you to Egypt, and I will surely bring you back.

genesis.46.p2.b1.text: Then Jacob departed from Beersheba, and the sons of Israel took their father Jacob in the wagons Pharaoh had sent to carry him,

genesis.46.p2.b2.text: They also took the livestock and possessions they had acquired in the land of Canaan,

genesis.46.p2.b3.text: and Jacob and all his offspring went to Egypt.

genesis.46.p3.b1.text: Now these are the names of the sons of Israel (Jacob and his descendants) who went to Egypt: Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn.

genesis.46.p3.b2.text: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, and Zerah; but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.

genesis.46.p3.b3.text: These are the sons of Leah born to Jacob in Paddan-aram, in addition to his daughter Dinah. The total number of sons and daughters was thirty-three.

genesis.46.p4.b1.text: These are the sons of Jacob born to Zilpah—… sixteen in all.

genesis.46.p4.b2.text: The sons of Jacob’s wife Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.

genesis.46.p4.b3.text: Manasseh and Ephraim were born to Joseph in the land of Egypt …

genesis.46.p4.b4.text: the members of Jacob’s family who went to Egypt were seventy in all.

genesis.46.p5.b1.text: Now Jacob had sent Judah ahead of him to Joseph to get directions to Goshen.

genesis.46.p5.b2.text: Joseph prepared his chariot and went there to meet his father Israel.

genesis.46.p5.b3.text: Joseph presented himself to him, embraced him, and wept profusely.

genesis.46.p5.b4.text: “Finally I can die, now that I have seen your face and know that you are still alive!”

genesis.46.p6.b1.text: “I will go up and inform Pharaoh: ‘My brothers and my father’s household from the land of Canaan have come to me.

genesis.46.p6.b2.text: When Pharaoh summons you and asks, ‘What is your occupation?’ you are to say, ‘Your servants have raised livestock ever since our youth—…’

genesis.46.p6.b3.text: Then you will be allowed to settle in the land of Goshen, since all shepherds are detestable to the Egyptians.
